findings.title: Zentrale Begriffe sind bei erster Verwendung nicht erklärt / Key terms lack first-use explanations
findings.evidence: intakes/LH-00.md:13-30 promises no Spec Kit experience; :45-46 uses integrations/presets, :127 and :140 collection roles/series manifest, :151 and :159 ASVS/SBOM/VEX/AI-SBOM without definitions. FR-00-005 (:121/:134) and AC-00-004 (:255/:265) require explained terms. The linked authoring profile repeats collection terminology without explaining it.
findings.impact: New authors cannot reliably distinguish a preset, project profile, collection or series manifest; readers cannot interpret the security N/A statements. This does not meet the declared beginner-facing language contract.
findings.remediation: Add equivalent DE/EN first-use explanations of the relevant workflow terms and security abbreviations. Preserve scope and requirement IDs; repeat a semantic language review.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: Authorized glossary/first-use amendment followed by full re-review; any audience or language-contract change

findings.disposition: Open - align normative translations before Ready
findings.title: Normative DE/EN-Fassungen sind nicht vollständig gleichwertig / Normative DE/EN text differs
findings.evidence: FR-00-004 at intakes/LH-00.md:120 requires linking issue IDs; its EN counterpart :133 additionally requires linking intakes. AC-00-007 at :258 says unabhängiges Review, while :268 only says separate review. AC-00-004 at :255/:265 requires matching meaning. Both differences also occur in the approved issue-01 source.
findings.impact: Required links and reviewer independence can be accepted differently depending on the selected language. Matching IDs alone do not prove equivalent requirements.
findings.remediation: Confirm and express the same linking obligation and review-independence requirement in both languages. Align any affected source/issue through explicitly authorized repair/update, preserving receipt lineage; do not silently rehash.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: Owner-authorized semantic alignment of the named clauses and any bound source updates, then a full re-review

reviewer.boundary: Separate review pass by the authoring agent; no independent-person, assistive-device, platform or process acceptance is claimed.
